beta.notes:
Fixes:
• Schoology refresh now detects submitted work despite stale Missing grades or incomplete reminders, and missing-work indicators follow the selected learning period.
• Course Activity and grading review are more stable, with clearer filed-sample replacement, undo, and task preview shortcuts.
• Fixed learning-period to-do toggling and resending corrected work samples.

stable.notes:
Fixes:
• Fixed the sample verification window reporting "All fields verified" when the date box was still empty. An automatically read date was stamped on the sample and counted as checked without ever being shown, so it could be saved without anyone seeing it.
